Our story

Built by a club parent, for club owners

Apps By Angela was built alongside the people who actually run clubs — coaches, administrators and club owners who told us exactly what they needed. What started as a solution for one gymnastics club grew into something much bigger.

Every single feature on the platform exists because a real club asked for it. Whether your members are juniors or adults, we listened, we built it, and we keep building — because club management should work the way clubs actually work.

Unlike the big corporate platforms that have been bought and sold by investors, Apps By Angela is independent, personal, and built by someone who has worked closely with clubs from the ground up — not a boardroom.

The platform

Not just an app. A complete platform.

When you sign up, you get three fully integrated products working together seamlessly.

📱
Member Mobile App

Your club's own branded app, live on the App Store and Google Play under your club name.

  • Your logo and colour scheme throughout
  • Works on iPhone, iPad and Android
  • iPad perfect for the self sign-in register in class
  • Parents manage bookings and view newsletters
  • Receive push notifications instantly
  • View waiting lists, accept or decline spaces
  • Shop for club merchandise and kit
  • Multiple parents linked to each child
🖥
Web Admin Panel

A powerful management dashboard accessible from any browser.

  • Full member management and applications
  • View and process payments and refunds
  • Manage classes, registers and timetables
  • Handle waiting list and parent requests
  • Manage competitions and events
  • Process merchandise orders
👔
Coach App

A dedicated view for your coaching team — assign coaches to classes and give them exactly what they need.

  • Coaches assigned to specific classes
  • Take registers directly from their phone
  • Coaches create their own skill cards & share with the team
  • Mark skill achievements per student
  • View their own coaching calendar
⚙
Full App Configuration

You're in control. Choose exactly which features are active for your club.

  • Toggle any feature on or off
  • Customise your member label (Gymnast, Dancer, etc.)
  • Choose which payment methods to accept
  • Configure your waiting list system
  • Control what parents and coaches can see
👥
User Roles & Permissions

Four distinct user types, each with the right level of access for their role.

  • Admin — full control of everything
  • Coach — registers, skill cards & recognition
  • Helper — parent volunteers with admin-controlled permissions
  • Member — parents & members aged 16+
  • Helper permissions set once and applied to all helpers
  • Sensitive areas always protected from helpers

Features

Everything your club needs

From day-to-day registers to competition management — all configurable, all in one place.

📋
Registers & Classes
  • Add, edit and delete classes
  • Take registers from phone or tablet
  • Members self sign-in with their own colour
  • Full registration history stored automatically
  • Allergies and photo consent visible on register
  • Remove a member — off the register instantly
👪
Members & Families
  • Multiple parents per child, each with own account
  • Members aged 16+ can register & manage their own account
  • Search members by name and instantly view parent contact details and login email
  • Membership applications and signed T&Cs stored
  • Waiting list with accept/decline workflow
  • Spaces system showing availability per class
  • Parent requests managed from admin panel
🔔
Notifications
  • Push notifications — not just email
  • Target by location, discipline or level
  • Schedule notifications in advance
  • Monthly fee reminders set and forget
  • Parents auto-subscribed when child joins class
  • Notify parents of skill achievements instantly
💳
Payments & Orders
  • Card payments via Stripe — no markup added
  • Bank transfer and cash also supported
  • Manage club fees and insurance types
  • In-app merchandise and kit shop
  • Multiple merchandise categories
  • Full order and payment history
  • Refund management from admin panel
🎍
Recognition & Skills
  • Customisable student recognition (day/week/month)

  • Track skill completion per student
  • Notify parents when a skill is achieved
📊
Club Management
  • Multiple locations under one account
  • Calendar for events, competitions, closed days
  • Staff profiles with roles and qualifications
  • Helper role — give parent volunteers controlled access with granular permissions
  • Private lessons management
  • Newsletters uploaded and shared in-app
  • Image carousel fully managed by club

FAQ

Common questions

Yes — completely. Your app is fully white-labelled with your club name, logo and colour scheme. It's listed on the App Store and Google Play under your club's name. Members will never see the Apps By Angela branding.
Not at all. The platform works for any club or organisation — dance schools, martial arts, swimming clubs, football academies, cheer, community groups and more. You can customise the member label to suit your club.
Yes. Apps By Angela fully supports multiple locations under a single account. You can send notifications to specific locations and manage separate class timetables across all sites.
Coaches get their own dedicated view. You assign coaches to specific classes, and they can take registers, create and share skill cards, mark skill achievements and recognise students — all from their phone.
Absolutely. Every feature can be toggled on or off from the App Settings panel. Payment methods, waiting list style, parent visibility, coach navigation — all fully configurable.
Card payments are processed securely through Stripe. Standard UK rates apply (1.5% + 20p per transaction for UK cards). We never add any markup on top — every penny goes straight to your club.
Your web admin panel is ready within 48 hours of setup, so you can start adding members and classes straight away. Both Android and iOS apps typically take 1–2 weeks for app store approval. We handle all submissions for you.
Absolutely. We work closely with clubs to build custom features and integrations. Get in touch and we'll discuss what's involved — we always aim to be fair and transparent on price.
The helper role is perfect for parent volunteers who assist at your club. Rather than giving them full admin access, you assign them a helper role and choose exactly what they can do — managing merchandise, entering competition results, handling the waiting list, viewing registers and more. They only ever see what you allow, and sensitive areas like billing, member editing and settings are always protected. You can update their permissions at any time from one simple screen.
No problem — as a club admin you can search for any member by name and instantly see which email address was used to register. You can then let the parent know so they can reset their password. No more starting from scratch or creating duplicate accounts!
Absolutely. Members aged 16 and over can sign up and manage their own account directly in the app — no parent or guardian needed. This makes Apps By Angela perfect for adult gymnastics, martial arts, dance, fitness clubs and more, not just junior clubs.
No long-term contracts. All plans are monthly and you can cancel at any time.

Privacy Policy

This app is a demo version of a club management app, provided for demonstration purposes only. It does not collect or store personal data from users.

Any sample data shown is fictional and used only to demonstrate features such as class bookings, private lessons, skill tracking, merchandise orders and notifications.

We do not collect or store any real names, emails, passwords, payment information, or sensitive data. You can request deletion of any demo account at any time by emailing angela@appsbyangela.co.uk. We will process your request within 48 hours.

Your Data (Website)

This website does not use cookies, analytics, or store any visitor data. Any personal information you provide via our contact form will be used only to reply to you and is never shared or sold.

Demo Use Only
